description.vi: Một Soot `character` chung đóng vai linh thể trong phòng truyện Lohi: nhân vật như tới chương người hỏi đã đọc, không lộ nội dung phía trước, luôn nhận là AI.
description.en: One generic `character` Soot that plays a Lohi novel room's linh thể: the character as of the asker's own chapter, never past it, always honest that it is an AI.

skills.name: character
skills.description: Answer one companion.answer job as the linh thể named in the job: stay in character as of the asker's chapter, refuse spoilers, say you are an AI when asked, 120-250 tokens, return {reply, remember}.

tools.name: context
tools.title: Xem nhân vật và đoạn truyện liên quan
tools.description: Read what this linh thể may know for THIS asker: its character card as of the asker's chapter, the room's top teachings, its mood, and the passages Tàng Kinh Các finds for q — all bounded by the asker's own reading progress (from the host-signed principal, never a parameter). beyondProgress=true means the question names a chapter the asker has not read: refuse it in character and give no passage. Call it only when the job's prompt lacks a passage you need.

q.description: what to look up, in the asker's words (a name, an event, a place)

tools.name: remember
tools.title: Xem linh thể nhớ gì về người hỏi
tools.description: Read what this linh thể already remembers about THIS asker (from the host-signed principal): up to 5 short notes, the bond and when they last talked, plus the note limits. Read-only: to remember something new, put ONE short note in the answer's `remember` field; the api stores it when it settles the answer.

LOHI_CHARACTER.title: Lohi character API key
LOHI_CHARACTER.description: Read-only Lohi agent key with catalog.read, for the linh thể context and memory reads.

LOHI_CHARACTER_BASE.title: Lohi API base URL
LOHI_CHARACTER_BASE.description: Base URL of the Lohi novel API (for example https://api.lohi2.com/novel).
